subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should WebChat's unresumable restart-recovery notice be persisted as a synthetic delivery-mirror transcript row, or should this issue wait for a broader restart-recovery design?
rationale: Current main still drops the WebChat notice, and the open linked PR has a focused transcript fallback but changes persisted session history, so maintainer intent is needed before adopting that contract.

options.title: Land Guarded Transcript Notice
options.body: Accept the linked PR's persistent delivery-mirror notice contract once conflicts and normal validation are resolved.

options.title: Request Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or recover-and-confirm behavior defines a more complete contract.

options.title: Close Linked PR And Re-scope
options.body: Decline the synthetic transcript-row approach and ask for a narrower replacement fix or design issue.

recommendation.title: Land Guarded Transcript Notice
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR's persistent delivery-mirror notice contract once conflicts and normal validation are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to both delivery-mirror transcript behavior and restart-deferral hardening, which are the two central contract surfaces for the decision.
